name: Stripe
summary: Read the billing and subscription signals you choose for a recipe.

setup.credential_label: Stripe connection approved in your own Hermes setup
setup.recommended_scope: Read-only access to the billing information you choose to summarize.
setup.customer_action: In your own setup, connect Stripe with read-only access and confirm which billing signals this recipe may read.

customer_setup.summary: Choose the Stripe business signals you want included; this connector cannot edit billing data.
steps: Decide which billing and subscription signals are useful for this recipe.
Approve read-only access inside your own Hermes setup.
Review one test summary before enabling a schedule.
customer_setup.secret_handling: Agent Recipes never asks for, displays, stores, or logs connection secrets. Complete authorization only in your customer-owned runtime.

verification.success_looks_like: A test brief summarizes the selected Stripe signals without creating, changing, or refunding anything.
steps: Confirm the selected billing signals appear in the plan.
Confirm no Stripe records were changed.

rollback.scope: Only the Stripe connection for this selected recipe.
steps: Pause this recipe before changing its connection.
Remove only this recipe's Stripe connection in your own runtime.
Leave unrelated recipes and Stripe connections unchanged.
